title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Distribution of property by father in his lifetime? 12260 views Q. Distribution of my wealth 1768 views Q. My father expired 3 years back and my mother expired a year ago. They left a rented house which is worth Rs 65 lakh. We are 3 brothers and 4 sisters. How this property which can easily be sold for 65 lakh, be distributed to the heirs? Please reply. 2282 views Q. Distribution of Property 1967 views Q. My question is on law of inheritance. We are 3 brothers and 1 sister my father is alive alhamdullilah with grace of allah My mother has expired in 1999. My question actually is my father is having a property in hyderabad and we want to sell the property and my father is having debts upto 85 lakhs no we have fixed the value of property at 1.4 cr. kindly suggest us how to divide the sale proceeds among 3 brothers and 1 sister . My father is still alive and as per shariah what will be the percentage given to sons and daughters . one more question is as my sister is married does my brother in law have any right to ask about the share or can he demand the share . does he have any right to talk about the share at all . one more thing i would like to add is that in the debt mentioned above 18 lakhs is due to our brother in law . kindly guide us on this issue. 1940 views Q. Who will be the legal heirs of a mentally ill sister? 3788 views Q. My late husband is survived by wife, two daughters and no son. also two full brothers and one step sister( same father different mother). kindly advice on shares of each. 1586 views Q. Property distribution among sons and daughters 55101 views Q. Property Distribution 2079 views Q. The father of one of my relative brother was expired around 15 years back. He has left a house where the rest of the family members are living. All the family members are willing to keep the house unsold until mother is alive. Whether it right or wrong 2241 views Q. I have married in 1978 and divorce my wife through Islamic law and I have paid and settled ithath, meher and other expenses. And also we had a baby girl which was my daughter paid her incidential expenses till she passes minor category and above fixed Rupees Thirty thousand on fixed deposit for her marriage expenses till she comes the marriage age. I have taken her studies expenses time to time through bank which they have utilised it. This was agreed by both the parties and paid through Jamat meanwhile my X wife got married to other gentleman. About 5 years before my daughter got married and used the 18years fixed amount utilised for her marriage so I have not paid any further money, because the 18years fixed amount was very sufficient for all the marriage expenses. Now, four days before my daughter and her husband came and harrass me to give more and more and a huge amount or a property from me. For your kind information I do not own any property in my name. And my present wife own property on her names. Please guide me and let me know through shariyat legally does my daughter have any rights to get the demanding money? Because they have given me a warning that they can sue me by Indian Court. Please revert me back as soon as possible. 1700 views Q. Share of daughter in father's property 2914 views Q. Assalaamu 'alaikkum respected teachers, This question is of utmost importance to a family here in INDIA at this time. Let me explain. A man Abdul Wahab had 4 children, 1 son named Idris and 3 daughters. He has a common property. Abdul Wahab and his wife passes away. NOW THE PROPERTY DOCUMENT IS NOT TRANSFERRED TO THE 4 CHILDREN. THE PROPERTY IS STILL IN ABDUL WAHAB's NAME. Son Idris looks after the affairs of this property. Now the son Idris also passes away. Idris has 5 sons, 4 daughters and 1 Wife. So now when the legal heirs of Abdul Wahab wanted to divide the property, the 3 daughters of Abdul Wahab take One share each and leave 2 shares to rest with the deceased Idris family. Now my question is, a. what is the ratio at which Idris share is partitioned among his wife and Children ? b. Who are the legal heirs of Idris ? c. If Idris's wife has a share ? As the property in question is not on Idris's name but of his father. Please reply this question as soon as possible as some family members makes an issue whether to give a share to the mother. Please give this question TOP PRIORITY. Assalaamu 'alaikkum, Mubeen. 1989 views Q. Regarding Division of my father's property 1862 views Q. My Brother-in-law had expired in 2003 survived by his mother, wife, a daughter, and two brothers (one elder and one younger ?? both married). Please advise the right division of his a) Property, b) Amount (blood money) arrange by the govt for the family. Please advise the division among the above mentioned family members in the light of Quran. May Allah take us to the right direction. 2533 views

(Fatwa: 244/71=TL/1430) (1) After paying due rights preceding inheritance, the property of late Idrees will be distributed in 16 shares, out of which 2 shares will go to his wife, 2 shares to each of his five sons and 1 share to each of his four daughter. (2) Yes, his wife will have her share. In case the property is in his father?s name, the share of late Idrees? wife will not be cancelled.
